 The captain of the Azerbaijan national football team, Emin Makhmudov, was presented with a special game jersey in honor of his last — 66th — match for the national team. 
 Before the start of the friendly match against the national team of Andorra, the General Secretary of the Association of Football Federations of Azerbaijan (AFFA) Jahangir Farajullayev presented the player with a jersey bearing the number 66.
 It should be noted that the Neftchi midfielder has been playing for the Azerbaijan national team since 2016. During this time, he has scored 15 goals in national team matches.
 Thanks to this record, Emin Makhmudov surpassed the previous record held by Gurban Gurbanov and became the top scorer in the history of our national team.
